opinion.headline: Why India should rethink its opposition to WTO plurilateral deals
opinion.hook: The 14th WTO ministerial conference highlighted a divide between multilateralism and plurilateralism.
opinion.summary: India advocates for multilateralism but faces a changing global trade landscape. The article suggests India should strategically engage with plurilateral agreements. This engagement should focus on MFN-based, open plurilaterals housed within the WTO. Such an approach allows India to shape rules and defend the multilateral trading system.
